findings.title: The real-app duel smoke (npm run test:duel-app-runtime) still expects a two-seat room, and the menu now defaults to a crew of 3
findings.claim: `scripts/network/duel-app-smoke.ts` clicks `host` and then `create-room` without choosing a crew. The menu's default crew is now 3, so the smoke creates a capacity-3 room and fails its own assertion `capacity === 2`. Its injected observer also still builds `duelCodec(2)`, so in a crew-3 room it cannot decode any message that carries player 2 (for example the away steward's presence command and its result). The plan's grep for two-player code covered `src/` and `tests/` but not `scripts/`.
findings.evidence: scripts/network/duel-app-smoke.ts:L105 (`click create-room` with no crew choice) and :L107 (`assert(... capacity === 2, 'Host made a two-seat duel room')`); src/renderer/src/ui/menuState.ts INITIAL_MENU `crew: 3` (diff L1783); src/renderer/src/ui/menu/HostForm.tsx:L17 submits `actions.host(menu.crew)`; scripts/network/duel-app-observer.ts:L13 `codec = duelCodec(2)`, used at :L56 and :L63; package.json:L19 `test:duel-app-runtime`. scripts/network/internet-app-smoke.ts:L109 and :L148 also click create-room at the default, so the internet run now plays with an empty third seat.
findings.why: This is the only end-to-end check of the packaged two-machine duel, and it is what the owner runs before a playtest build. It now fails at step 1 for a reason unrelated to the app. The internet smoke silently changes from a two-seat run to a three-seat run with an away character.
findings.fix: In duel-app-smoke.ts, click `crew-2` before `create-room`, to keep the two-seat proof (or assert `capacity === 3` and accept the empty seat). Change duel-app-observer.ts:L13 to `duelCodec(DUEL_CREW_MAX)`. In internet-app-smoke.ts, click `crew-2` before `create-room` in both duel paths (L109, L148), so the run stays the two-seat run it was before this branch.

verified: The crew size travels end to end. The menu store's crew (default 3) goes to `actions.host` (actions.ts:L96), then to `api().host({mode:'duel',capacity})`, then the preload (preload/index.ts:L35), then `validateOnlineAction` (onlineSession.ts:L79, strict keys and 2|3|4). Main uses `action.capacity` for the room (main onlineSession.ts:L421). `duelInit` uses `playerCount: snapshot.capacity` (2..4) and checks helmPlayer < crew (onlineDuel.ts:L113-118). From there: encounterMode `options.producers({init})` → `createDuelProducers({playerCount: init.playerCount})` (duel.ts:L194) → `duelRules.create` → `createDuel(..., init.playerCount)` (duelRules.ts:L31) → `rules.playerCount(s) = interior.playerCount`, which sizes the core's held arrays and ledger (core.ts:L50-61) → `saveDuelSnapshot` header `playerCount: d.interior.playerCount` → duelClient `crew = header.playerCount` (duelClient.ts:L689-691). No link still assumes 2.

The guest's committed-start check compares every init field except helmPlayer, playerCount included, against its own expected init built from the room capacity (onlineDuel.ts:L40-51). Rehost validates the mirror with the room capacity (main onlineSession.ts:L350 → onlineModes adapter → `validateDuelMirror(mirror, capacity)`).

Empty seats. `desired` is `playerCount` long and the steward loop runs to `playerCount` (duelProducers.ts:L235, L244). An unattached seat gets the existing steward, which sends a ledgered presence false, so it is deterministic and in every snapshot. tests/duelOnlineCrew.test.ts:L598-611 shows the applied presence false, `present [true,true,false]` on both replicas, and no peer-lost pause. `startRound` copies `d.present.slice()` (step.ts:L1423), so an empty seat stays away after a rematch; crewOfFour.test.ts:L2107-2116 covers this.

Start rules. `startAllowed` ignores unclaimed seats and requires claimed seats to be ready and connected (menuState.ts:L1808). Main's `allReady` does the same over every seat (onlinePeers.ts:L185). The peer loop runs to `capacity` (onlinePeers.ts:L159). uiMenuState.test.ts:L3292-3301 covers it.

The all-down loss counts all n characters, away ones included (health.ts diff L1095-1099). Only present characters revive (`revivers`, diff L1053-1054). Telemetry's `allDowned` uses `crew.every` (telemetry.ts:L1650).

Two-player byte identity by construction. At n = 2 the presence field names are `present.0` and `present.1`, created once per crew size (modules.ts diff L1118-1126). The round offset `1+space+n+3` equals the old `+2+3`. Snapshot, telemetry, memory and summary arrays keep their n = 2 lengths and their key order. The codec at limit 4 changes validation only: encoding is `JSON.stringify(schema.parse(msg))` with unchanged key order (codec.ts:L218), and the per-player summary arrays and publication watermark bounds only widen what is admitted. Commands from players ≥ n are still refused by binding ownership (encounterMode.ts:L115 `validPlayers(players, count)`; core.ts:L315) and by the n-player ledger.

Snapshot, checkpoint and init at n. The header crew must be in 2..4 and within the layout's spawns. The layout cache stays one entry per layout object, with a per-crew `{interiorCount, tickOffset}` (snapshot.ts diff L1173-1197). `interior[5]` and `interior[9]` must equal n. `loadDuelSnapshot` creates at n. `restoreDuelSnapshot` and the replica's `matches` refuse a crew mismatch. The checkpoint ties `snapshot.header.playerCount` and every per-player array to `init.playerCount`, and builds an n-player ledger (duelCheckpoint.ts:L104-109).

Remaining two-player sites. Grepping `0 | 1`, `[0, 1]`, `=== 0 ? 1`, `< 2` and `PLAYERS` over src/ leaves only Single player (runtime.ts:L183, 241, 262-273, 351), the scripted pair (scripted.ts:L226-321), ship pairs (summary, telemetry, fxModel, weaponsModel) and contact ids. These are all intentional. consoleModel online now passes `otherSeat: 'standing'`, which only Single player's Tab used (consoleModel.ts:L62, L80).

The view widenings are n-generic or pooled at 4. Interior labels are DUEL_CREW_MAX long (interiorView.ts:L71, L83, indexed by `c.pid` with a guard at :L159-160). healFx and crewLife map over the crew. crewSprites colours use `pid % 4`. The sit tracker is sized from the crew each frame (scene.ts diff L491-492). `gunnerPresent`/`stateAxes` index `present[pid]`.

The crew list. `crewStatus` precedence is DOWNED, AWAY, the console, REPAIRING (repairInReach plus repair or extinguish progress, Decision 5), then ON FOOT (readoutModel.ts:L913-922). Rows are labelled `P<k>`; DOWNED has alert emphasis and AWAY a dim value. Counting rows at n = 4: the interior column's longest list is 22 (≤ READOUT_ROWS 23, which ReadoutPanel.tsx:L46 caps). The Weapons console list is 15 rows, and STATUS.y 42 + 2·PAD + 15·LINE 24 = 418 ≤ stationTop('weapons') 492 (consoleLayout.ts:L9-11). It fits.

The SCIENCE badge comes after WEAPONS and before MEDBAY, with tint always normal and no badge when `d.science < 0` (interiorModel.ts diff L835). It appears on both the Hound and the Cutter, as in Decision 7, and stationBadges.test.ts covers both.

Lobby labels are EMPTY, JOINED, READY and DISCONNECTED for a duel only (menuState.ts:L85-88), one row per seat up to capacity (SessionPage.tsx:L33). The CREW 2 3 4 buttons are type=button, so they never submit, and use aria-pressed. Focus goes to create-room. menu.test.tsx:L3017-3033 covers this.

Test lines: grepping the diff for an added line with a trailing `//` comment followed by `expect(`/`assert(` finds none. The one that was swallowed earlier (menu.test.tsx:L3006-3008) is fixed. The new tests check real values (lengths, statuses, hashes, results), not just that nothing throws.
tests/duelGates.test.ts is absent from the branch diff's file list (gate bands untouched). Single player still creates two characters (runtime createDuel at the default crew 2).

The reading went past the manifest in a few places, each to check a named risk: core.ts:L40-119 and encounterMode.ts:L85-134 (player bounds), hostRuntime.ts and onlinePeers.ts (peer and seat loops), consoleLayout.ts and ReadoutPanel.tsx (row fit), crewSprites.ts, healFxModel.ts and interiorView.ts (pooled views), and scripts/network/duel-app-smoke.ts, duel-app-observer.ts and internet-app-smoke.ts (the finding).
